# TextRazor

TextRazor is a natural language processing API that extracts meaning, entities, and relationships from text, powering advanced content analysis and sentiment detection

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/textrazor/.

## Actions

- **Analyze Content with TextRazor** (read-only): A comprehensive content analysis tool that combines multiple textrazor extractors to perform a complete analysis of the input text.
- **Analyze Dependency Trees** (read-only): The dependencytreesaction analyzes the grammatical relationships between words in text by creating dependency trees.
- **Classify Text** (read-only): This tool will classify text into predefined categories using textrazor's classification capabilities.
- **Dictionary Manager**: The textrazor dictionary manager tool allows users to create, update, and manage custom entity dictionaries in textrazor.
- **Extract Entailments from Text** (read-only): This tool extracts entailments from text using textrazor's api.
- **Extract Grammatical Relations from Text** (read-only): This tool extracts grammatical relations between words in the text.
- **Extract Named Entities from Text** (read-only): Extract named entities (people, places, companies, etc.) from text using textrazor's entity extraction api.
- **Extract Phrases from Text** (read-only): The extractphrases action extracts meaningful phrases from input text using textrazor's phrase extraction capability.
- **Extract Topics from Text** (read-only): A tool to extract topics from text using textrazor's topic extraction capabilities.
- **Extract Word Senses** (read-only): This tool performs word sense disambiguation on the input text by identifying the most likely meanings of words in context.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): This tool retrieves comprehensive information about a textrazor account, providing essential details about the account's status, usage,…
- **Manage Custom Classifiers**: This tool manages custom classifiers in textrazor, allowing users to create, update, and manage custom classification categories.
- **Spelling Correction** (read-only): This tool performs spelling correction on the provided text using textrazor's deep spelling correction system.
